description: This file defines interfaces and functions related to updating Kubernetes API objects, including validation, preparation, canonicalization, and object transformation strategies for update operations within the Kubernetes API server.

classes.name: RESTUpdateStrategy
classes.description: Interface defining the update strategy for Kubernetes objects, including validation, normalization, and canonicalization methods.

classes.name: defaultUpdatedObjectInfo
classes.description: Implementation of UpdatedObjectInfo that holds an object and optional transformers for updating objects.

classes.name: wrappedUpdatedObjectInfo
classes.description: Implementation that wraps another UpdatedObjectInfo and chains additional transformers.

methods.name: validateCommonFields
methods.description: Validates common metadata fields for new and old objects based on the update strategy.

methods.name: BeforeUpdate
methods.description: Performs common pre-update operations, validation, and canonicalization on objects before updating.

methods.name: DefaultUpdatedObjectInfo
methods.description: Factory function to create a DefaultUpdatedObjectInfo with optional transformers.

methods.name: Preconditions
methods.description: Returns preconditions (like UID) for the updated object.

methods.name: UpdatedObject
methods.description: Returns a transformed copy of the object, applying any configured transformers.

methods.name: WrapUpdatedObjectInfo
methods.description: Wraps an existing UpdatedObjectInfo with additional transformers.

methods.name: AdmissionToValidateObjectUpdateFunc
methods.description: Converts an admission.Interface into a ValidateObjectUpdateFunc for validation during updates.
